[EN] Dark Faeries
[ES] Hadas oscuras
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] The {@creature:46#304#argonomorph jalmaraks} have argonized horns that we need to study.
[ES] Los {@creature:46#304#argonomorph jalmaraks} tienen cuernos con argón que necesitamos estudiar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] If the argons can corrupt a faerie, we're in big trouble.
[ES] Si los argones pueden corromper a un hada, estamos en graves problemas.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Argonized Horn
[ES] Cuerno con argón
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill {@creature:46#304#argonomorph jalmaraks} in the {@Rgn:46007$$Raga Evala Depths} and get argonized horns.
[ES] Mata a los {@creature:46#304#argonomorph jalmaraks} en las {@Rgn:46007$$Raga Evala Depths} y consigue cuernos con argón.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go back to the entrance of the {@Rgn:46007$$Raga Evala Depths} and deliver the argonized horns to {@creature:246#1029$$Gloann}.
[ES] Regresa a la entrada de {@Rgn:46007$$Raga Evala Depths} y entrégale los cuernos argonizados a {@creature:246#1029$$Gloann}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll head there presently."
[ES] "Iré para allá de inmediato."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I thank you."
[ES] "Te lo agradezco".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to {@creature:246#1102$$Nevian} in the {@Rgn:46016$$Mindcrown Chamber} in the {@Rgn:46008$$Raga Kabash Depths}.
[ES] Ve con {@creature:246#1102$$Nevian} en la {@Rgn:46016$$Mindcrown Chamber} dentro de las {@Rgn:46008$$Raga Kabash Depths}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
